title: ListTimeZoneResponse
description: Response schema for the TimezoneDB list-time-zone endpoint. Returns a list of all supported timezones, optionally filtered by country or zone name pattern.

message.description: Error message; empty string if successful.

TimeZoneEntry.description: A single timezone entry with location and offset information.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the timezone.

countryName.description: Full country name of the timezone.

gmtOffset.description: The UTC offset in seconds. Positive values are east of UTC, negative are west.

dst.description: Daylight Saving Time flag. 0 = No DST, 1 = DST currently active.

timestamp.description: Current local time as a Unix timestamp.
